# package chaos

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canbus/chaos"
```

Package chaos injects faults between two CAN transports.

A [Bridge](#type-bridge) forwards frames from one transport to another (for example between two vcan interfaces, or a vcan interface and a virtual bus) and, with a seeded pseudo-random generator, drops, duplicates, delays, reorders and corrupts them. Put it between two peers that are each connected to only one side, and every frame between them crosses it: this tests real implementations (the Linux kernel's ISO-TP, other stacks, devices on a bench bus) under faults no physical bus would produce on demand.

Between two \[canbus.XLTransport]s (CAN XL sockets, virtual bus ports opened with CAN XL) CAN XL frames are forwarded too, with the same faults.

Faults are userspace emulation of what a receiver sees. They do not model bit errors, arbitration or the retransmissions a real controller performs after a CRC error: corruption here delivers a frame that a real bus would have rejected.

## Types

### type Bridge

```go
type Bridge struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Bridge forwards frames from one transport to another with faults.

#### func New

```go
func New(cfg Config) (*Bridge, error)
```

New returns a bridge. Probabilities outside 0..1 are an error.

#### func (Bridge) Both

```go
func (b *Bridge) Both(ctx context.Context, x, y canbus.Transport) error
```

Both runs the bridge in both directions between x and y until ctx ends or one direction fails, and returns the first error.

#### func (Bridge) Run

```go
func (b *Bridge) Run(ctx context.Context, src, dst canbus.Transport) (err error)
```

Run forwards frames from src to dst until ctx ends or src fails; it returns nil when ctx ended. Error frames and src's own echoes are not forwarded. CAN XL frames are forwarded when src and dst are \[canbus.XLTransport]s. Run may be started once per direction.

#### func (Bridge) Stats

```go
func (b *Bridge) Stats() Stats
```

Stats returns the counters.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	Seed      int64         // seeds the generator (default 1)
	Drop      float64       // a frame is not forwarded
	Duplicate float64       // a frame is forwarded twice
	Delay     float64       // a frame is held for DelayBy (later frames wait behind it)
	DelayBy   time.Duration // default 5 ms
	Reorder   float64       // a frame is held back and sent after the next one
	Corrupt   float64       // one payload bit is flipped
	// Filter limits the faults to matching frames; others pass untouched.
	Filter *canbus.FilterSet
}
```

Config sets the fault probabilities (0..1) of a Bridge.

### type Stats

```go
type Stats struct {
	Received   uint64 `json:"received"`
	Forwarded  uint64 `json:"forwarded"`
	Dropped    uint64 `json:"dropped"`
	Duplicated uint64 `json:"duplicated"`
	Delayed    uint64 `json:"delayed"`
	Reordered  uint64 `json:"reordered"`
	Corrupted  uint64 `json:"corrupted"`
	// SkippedXL counts CAN XL frames the destination cannot send (it is no
	// XLTransport, or reports canbus.ErrUnsupported).
	SkippedXL uint64 `json:"skippedXL"`
}
```

Stats counts what a bridge did.
